answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. The system's strength comes from the fact that reputation is spent against performance, so a flood of accounts is filtered by the same economics that reward real work.
